proposed_rules.trigger: An FAQ answer node marked [region] appears as a sibling of the FAQ container (or at document root) instead of nested under its question, because the source DOM renders the open/absolute-positioned answer outside its accordion-item parent.
proposed_rules.decision: Re-attach the orphan [region] answer to the accordion row of the question it textually matches; do not treat it as separate page content or a new section.
proposed_rules.rationale: The visual-tree capture promotes elements rendered outside their DOM parent (overlays/fixed/absolute nodes); this is a capture-time positional artifact, not authored structure.

provenance.evidence: C203 rc2c11, rc4 (orphan [region] FAQ answer text)

proposed_rules.trigger: A recurring footer zone with the tagline 'The best no-code platform for...' plus a thin '| |' separator node, present near the bottom of every page.
proposed_rules.decision: Model as global site-wide footer chrome (fragment), excluded from per-page block/content inventory.
proposed_rules.rationale: Rejected alternatives: (a) map as page-level default-content since it does carry text, (b) map as a dedicated 'footer' block. Chose fragment-exclusion because the exact same text recurs verbatim across unrelated pages, indicating shared site chrome rather than page-authored content.

notes: Standard marketing page: hero, mixed text sections, one feature-card block, and a confirmed FAQ accordion; two capture artifacts (leaked JS/CSS text, orphan FAQ-answer regions) and cookie overlay are noise.
